item.title: 介电和压电响应的原子分辨机器学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jinyu Liu, Yingwei Chen, Liyang Ma, Hongyu Yu, Hongjun Xiang
预测结构复杂材料中的介电和压电响应需要大型模拟单元，而密度泛函微扰理论 (DFPT) 的计算规模为 O(N⁴)，计算量巨大。然而，机器学习方法仍然具有挑战性，要么受到直接回归所需的大量昂贵的 DFPT 数据的限制，要么受到重建的立方成本的限制。

item.title: Computational Investigation and Defect-Related Optimization of Lead-Free Cs₂AgBiBr₆ Double-Perovskite Solar Cells Using DFT, SCAPS-1D, and Machine Learning
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Sameer Pandey¹
The lead-free double perovskite materials have become attractive alternatives to the traditional lead-based photovoltaic (PV) absorbers in view of their relatively low toxicity to the environment. The electronic complexities and simulated PV performances of the lead-free double perovskite Cs₂AgBiBr₆ were investigated using complementary computational tools such as Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations, device simulation through the SCAPS-1D code, and Machine Learning (ML). In the electronic structure calculations, we have used the quantum ESPRESSO package, with the generalized gradient approximation (GGA-PBE) functional. The electronic properties of Cs₂AgBiBr₆ were studied using DFT calculations at the self-consistent field (SCF) convergence, total density of states (TDOS), and pro…

item.title: Library of carbon nanotube junctions: data-driven insights into structure-magnetotransport relationships
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Juan Alberto Canché-Martín, Teresa Kulka, Jacek A. Majewski, Irina V. Lebedeva, Maciej Marchwiany, Karolina Z. Milowska
arXiv:2609.29459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electronic transport in carbon nanotube (CNT) assemblies is controlled by a heterogeneous population of CNT--CNT junctions, yet most microscopic studies consider only a few representative systems. Two complementary transport descriptors reveal distinct structure--transport hierarchies. The averaged first transmission-step value is governed…

item.title: Explainable Point-Cloud Deep Learning for 3D Conformation Recognition of Temperature-Sensitive Bottlebrush Polymers
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Amirul Islam Saimon, Soumil Joshi, Jihoon Chung, Blake Johnson, Sanket Deshmukh, Zhenyu Kong
Bottlebrush polymers (BBPs) exhibit highly tunable physicochemical properties arising from their unique 3D architectures of densely grafted side chains. Accurately recognizing and classifying their conformations is critical for understanding structure-property relationships, yet remains challenging due to the complex geometries. Coarse-grained molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can generate 3D BBP conformations as bead-level coordinates that provide point cloud data for quantitative shape analysis. Conventional approaches either compress these data into hand-crafted geometric descriptors or discretize the structures onto 3D grids (voxelization) before applying data-driven models. item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kushaal Kumar Pothula, Arunav Kumar
arXiv:2609.29514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct numerical simulation of magnetic reconnection is limited by the scale separation of resistive magnetohydrodynamics. At large Lundquist numbers S the current layer thins as S⁻¹/², forcing fine grids and short time steps that make parameter scans prohibitively expensive. Deep learning neural operators offer an alternative by learning the map between function spaces rather than individual solutions, so that a single trained model returns the state for any parameter and time at inference cost. We have developed a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) based Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) surrogate for two-dimensional compressible, viscous, resistive reconnection in a wall bounded domain. item.title: 用于 316L 不锈钢氢脆检测的泄漏安全机器学习：SEM 显微照片中纹理和深层特征的区域保留评估
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Muhammad Awais, Muhammad Yaseen, Abdul Shakoor, Niaz Ahmed Niaz, Huria Zia, Muhammad Zain Shakoor
扫描电子显微镜 (SEM) 通常用于表征结构钢中氢脆 (HE) 引起的微观结构变化。机器学习可以自动执行此表征，但通常使用图像级分割来评估模型。当多个图像来自同一样本区域时，这种分割会泄漏训练集和测试集之间的信息。在这里，我们提出了一种区域保留协议，用于对 316L 不锈钢的原样 (AR) 和充氢 (H2) SEM 显微照片进行分类，基于 14 个空间区域（8 个 AR、6 H2；31 个图像）的留一区域排除 (LORO) 交叉验证。

item.description:

arXiv:2609.29105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: General-purpose machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) for organic reactions need to be accurate on both the minimum energy path (MEP) for static evaluation of basic properties and the broader configurational space for simulating reaction dynamics. Existing general datasets for gas-phase organic reactions rely on quasi-static relaxation that confines configurations to the MEP vicinity, so models trained on them could fail on direct molecular-dynamics trajectories; the gap is methodological, not a question of dataset size. We introduce a spatiotemporally resolved, system-independent collective variable (CV): Cartesian RMSD within randomly partitioned local domains against an expanding list of time-averaged reference geometries. The C…

item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Weiyun Xu, Jiamu Liu
arXiv:2609.29024v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Natural load-bearing and transport networks are not assembled in a single step; they emerge through a temporally ordered process of growth, branching, reinforcement, and loop formation. Inspired by this developmental logic, this work introduces a morphogenetic graph-generation framework for mechanical lattices in which a discrete dot matrix provides potential nodes and the final architecture is created by sequential cross-layer and intra-layer growth. The same rule is visualized in two dimensions as a leaf-vein-like developmental sequence and implemented in three dimensions on a 3x3x3 nodal matrix containing 27 candidate nodes. A dataset of distinct three-dimensional lattices was evaluated by beam-based finite element analysis and represen…

item.title: 迭代乘法的 RLVR 景观可能是良性的：来自自旋玻璃理论的见解
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Noa Rubin, Zohar Ringel
尽管具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）很重要，但它能够在多大程度上学习新的推理能力仍然存在争议。在这里，我们研究 RLVR 在算法任务上的优化前景，例如迭代群和拟群乘法。为此，我们将近视表格策略上的熵正则化 RLVR 映射到确定性策略上的基于能量的（自旋玻璃）模型。这种映射限制了 RLVR 可以实现的目标，并让我们能够严格描述此表格设置中的景观。我们从理论上和实验上证明，对于具有不相关输入的各种模型和任务来说，这种情况是良性的，不包含可能陷入 RLVR 训练的局部最小值。

item.title: SAGE: Mitigating Long-Horizon Reasoning Biases via Topological Guidance
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xinyue Zeng, Jiawei Zhang, Yujun Yan, Dawei Zhou
arXiv:2609.30192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon reasoning remains a central challenge for large language models (LLMs) under sparse-reward regimes. We argue that this brittleness arises from two biases induced by complex reasoning spaces: an exploration bias, where models are drawn toward locally plausible but structurally unstable branches, and a compounding bias, where small local deviations accumulate across depth and suppress rare rewards. We introduce Symbolic Closure Analysis (SCA) as a theoretical lens characterizing how branching structures and sparse rewards induce these biases in long-horizon reasoning with local admissibility, and as a design principle for structural priors in less formal reasoning tasks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose SAGE (Structural Admi…

item.title: 探索火星条件下CO2射频放电频率效应的操作员学习
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zheng Zhao, Xiaolong Wang, Yuantao Zhang
火星条件下的二氧化碳（ CO2 ）转化对于未来的太空探索和可持续碳利用都越来越重要。在这里，我们开发了一个基于深度运营商网络（ DeepONet ）的运营商学习框架，以解决火星大气压下射频（ RF ）二氧化碳排放的频率依赖性行为。采用高保真和自洽的流体模型，加上涉及26种和278种反应的简化动力学机制，来构建捕获强耦合时空等离子体动力学的高维数据集。

item.description:

👤 Pai Li
arXiv:2609.29595v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The automated generation of three-dimensional atomic structures from natural-language descriptions remains a persistent challenge, as large language models lack intrinsic geometric reasoning. We introduce ATLAS, a holistic framework that integrates seven modular components-ranging from a density-based structure analyzer and a JSON-based semantic bridge to a deterministic build engine, physical validator, and intent-aware scorer-to translate user prompts into physically valid coordinates. The build engine executes a component algebra that encompasses named structures, unary and binary operations (supercell, resizing, rotation, translation, union, subtraction, intersection), and geometric variables, while the validator enforces periodic-bounda…

item.title: 超导体中希格斯模式的玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚的界限
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Z. E. Krix, Daniel Loss
超导体中的集体模式对应于序参数的振幅（希格斯模式）或相位（戈德斯通模式）的波动。从 BCS 哈密顿量开始，我们推导出希格斯-戈德斯通-电子耦合系统的微观哈密顿量，其中包含这些自由度之间的所有相互作用。希格斯子系统是一种弱相互作用的玻色气体：希格斯模式经历由博戈留波夫准粒子对的虚拟交换介导的相互吸引。它们还与外部电磁场相互作用，并具有我们明确推导的耦合常数。我们利用这个理论来研究希格斯模式的光泵浦气体是否可以发生玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚。

item.title: 混合铁反铁呼吸烧绿石从降维到四聚
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Sourin Chatterjee, Kelvin Salou-Smith, Benedikt Schneider, Imre Hagymási, Arnaud Ralko, Johannes Reuther 等11位作者
我们研究了混合铁反铁磁体系中呼吸烧绿石晶格的自旋 1/2 最近邻海森堡模型，其中一个四面体亚晶格是反铁磁的，另一个是铁磁的。经典的基态流形是由复合四面体矩构建的最近邻面心立方（fcc）反铁磁体的流形。经典蒙特卡罗模拟和自洽高斯近似表明，热有序无序提升了其次广简并性，并通过强一阶跃迁选择波矢 X=(1,0,0) 的共线 I 型态。 S=1/2 和 S=1 的赝费米子函数重正化群计算揭示了邻近解耦反铁磁四面体极限的非磁性窗口，超过该窗口 X 阶会重新出现。

item.title: 一维手性量子系统拓扑相变的对数输运
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Dragan Markovic, Hermann Schulz-Baldes
随机跳跃哈密顿量是一维手性哈密顿量中无序驱动的拓扑相变的玩具模型。它具有消失的李亚普诺夫指数和零能量状态密度的戴森峰。这项工作展示了量子动力学如何导致位置算子矩的对数增长，类似于经典的西奈扩散。这种现象的起源机制是最小特征值的特征函数可以通过经典随机游走的指数很好地逼近，从而产生两个本质上独立的次指数定位中心。

item.title: Mixed-Valent Magnetism in CeFe₂ from Multi-Impurity DFT+DMFT
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Basile Herzog, Vladislav Borisov, Olle Eriksson
arXiv:2609.29241v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The microscopic origin of magnetism in CeFe₂ has remained unresolved for almost forty years, where polarized-neutron diffraction and x-ray magnetic circular dichroism infer markedly different Ce 4f spin and orbital moments, that also are in disagreement with theory. We show here that within a relativistic multi-impurity DFT+DMFT framework, where the Fe 3d states are treated by spin-polarized T-matrix fluctuation exchange and Ce 4f orbitals by a bath-coupled configuration-interaction solver, this long standing problem is resolved. This level of theory is exclusive in reproducing magnetic moments (spin and orbital) for both the Ce and Fe atoms, yielding a total moment in agreement with the measured saturation moment. The theory put forth here…

item.title: Nodal Orbital-Anti-Phase Superconducting State in Bilayer Nickelates
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Marius Scholten, Steffen Bötzel, Frank Lechermann, Rafael M. Fernandes, Ilya M. Eremin
arXiv:2609.29263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The recent discovery of high-T_c superconductivity in the bilayer nickelate La₃Ni₂O₇ (La-327) under applied pressure and compressive strain opened a new avenue to elucidate the interplay between multiorbital intralayer and interlayer electronically driven Cooper-pairing in bilayer systems. Depending on the details of the electronic structure in the normal state, the superconducting gap in bilayer nickelates is predicted to have either bonding-antibonding s±-wave symmetry, driven by dominant interlayer Cooper-pairing, or d-wave symmetry with substantial intralayer Cooper-pairing. Despite this general picture, the orbital structure of the superconducting gap in these multiorbital systems has been less explored. Here, we analyze the consequence…

item.title: 投影非晶拓扑绝缘体
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Archisman Panigrahi, Bitan Roy
我们引入了投影非晶拓扑绝缘体（PATI），尽管仅包含一小部分（x）否则随机选择的母晶体的断开位点，但当通过积分原始晶格的剩余位点来构造其有效哈密顿量时，具有量子化全局拓扑不变量（强PATI）。此外，在父模型的拓扑机制中，存在一个临界x，低于该临界x，此类系统会产生非常脆弱的PATI，仅支持其中一小部分位点上的量化局部拓扑标记。强 PATI 和脆弱 PATI 都可以容纳边界附近的带隙模式。

item.title: Superconductivity in structurally complex σ-Phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, Ta) and a derived medium-entropy alloys
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pavan Kumar Meena, Tomasz Klimczuk
arXiv:2609.29354v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The structurally complex tetragonal sigma (σ)-phase provides a unique platform for investigating the interplay between chemical disorder, electronic structure, and superconductivity, particularly in Re-based alloys where unconventional superconductivity has been widely discussed. Here, we synthesize and investigate the superconducting properties of σ-phase Re-X (X = V, Nb, and Ta) alloys with compositions Re₀.₇₆V₀.₂₄, Re₀.₅₆Nb₀.₄₄, and Re₀.₆₀Ta₀.₄₀. These compositions lie within the narrow stability range of the σ phase, underscoring the critical role of valence electron concentration in phase formation. To examine the influence of enhanced chemical disorder, we further synthesize the structurally complex medium-entropy alloy Re₀.₅₆Nb₀.₁₉Ta₀…

item.title: Theory of extrinsic contributions to the full orbital current
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 James H Cullen, Dimitrie Culcer
arXiv:2609.28628v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The orbital Hall effect (OHE) underpins the emerging field of orbitronics. A complete quantum-mechanical evaluation of the usual orbital-current operator must retain all matrix elements of the position operator, including its band-diagonal differential part; intrinsic calculations based on this full evaluation can differ by orders of magnitude from the conventional truncation. A relaxation-time estimate of disorder effects on the full current has been reported, but a microscopic treatment of extrinsic scattering has remained unavailable because the position operator requires wavevector-off-diagonal density-matrix elements. item.title: Real-space determination of orbital states driving successive phase transitions in FeV2O4
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Chihaya Koyama, Yusuke Nomura, Shunsuke Kitou, Taishun Manjo, Yuiga Nakamura, Takeshi Hara 等11位作者
arXiv:2604.04398v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Direct experimental access to orbital states in strongly correlated materials remains a major challenge, despite their central role in driving coupled structural and magnetic phase transitions. In systems where electronic correlations, electron-lattice coupling, and relativistic spin-orbit interactions compete on comparable energy scales, even first-principles calculations often yield multiple metastable solutions, hindering the unambiguous identification of the ground state. Here, we demonstrate that the orbital states of the spinel oxide FeV2O4, which possesses active orbital degrees of freedom on both Fe and V ions, are uniquely resolved by combining valence electron density (VED) analysis based on state-of-the-art synchrotron x-ray d…

item.title: Symmetry-protected intraband exciton-phonon scattering and its breakdown by mass asymmetry
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Michael O. Atambo
arXiv:2609.29634v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coupling of excitons to lattice vibrations is typically treated via phenomenological models that artificially separate long-range Fröhlich and short-range Holstein interactions. Recent analytical work has established that, in the delocalized limit, Fröhlich scattering is suppressed by electron--hole interference. Here we present a model-space Bethe--Salpeter framework to evaluate exciton--phonon coupling across the extended-to-localized crossover. We establish a fundamental distinction between the emphinclusive exciton--phonon coupling weight, obtainable via an exact completeness sum rule without summation over excited states, and the emphexclusive intraband (internal-state-preserving) scattering amplitude that governs low-energy decoher…

item.title: 通过Floquet对称转换实现Altermagnetic Kondo逻辑
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haojie Shen, Xinchen Zhou, Baigeng Wang, Rui Wang
近藤物理学的一个普遍信念是，磁性杂质可以作为其主浴关键特性的有效探针。然而，在替代磁体中，这种直觉以对称强制的方式失败：动量依赖的自旋分裂抵消了局部杂质光谱，使得传统的单纯近藤共振基本上对替代磁性形状因子视而不见。在这里，我们通过引入Floquet对称转换来克服这一限制。我们表明，平面内交流场将隐藏的变磁自旋分裂转换为局部可检测的自旋依赖杂交通道，该通道通过近藤相关进一步放大为新的变磁近藤效应。

item.title: Antisymmetric breathing in altermagnetic skyrmions
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yunxi Jiang, Chen Xuan, Xi Chen, Zhikai Wang, Qinfeng Zhu, Hao Yu
arXiv:2609.29190v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A skyrmion in an altermagnet with (d) wave symmetry consists of two elliptical sublattice textures with perpendicular long axes. For each sublattice component η=A,B, we define an effective skyrmion radius R_η=sqrta_η b_η, where a_η and b_η are the distances from the skyrmion center to its boundary along y and x, respectively. For the anisotropic exchange parameters studied, the equilibrium radius at zero field is smaller than in a reference with parallel sublattice textures and otherwise identical parameters. A magnetic field perpendicular to the film expands one sublattice skyrmion and contracts the other, generating a radius difference dR=R_A-R_B and a net magnetic moment. The exchange modulation used to represent uniaxial strain also prod…

item.title: 量子纠缠态的联想记忆
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Qiyuan Hu, Kartiek Agarwal, Ivar Martin
我们概括了联想记忆的规范霍普菲尔德模型，该模型存储单个自旋的经典状态，以存储纠缠的量子态。该构造基于截断的投影求和哈密顿量，并且我们明确考虑存储自旋 1/2 系统的二聚体单重态覆盖的特殊情况。我们分析了存储存储器的稳定性，发现容量（稳定模式的数量）随着系统规模的增加而扩展得比与标准霍普菲尔德模型的朴素类比所预期的更快，这表明可能存在量子优势。

item.title: 来自连续场理论的相互竞争的磁性和自旋退化秩序
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Niccolò Francini, Lukas Janssen
我们研究具有竞争性反铁磁和自旋向列相位的磁性系统，由偶极子初级和四极子次级序参数描述。当反铁磁相打破时间反转和自旋旋转对称性时，只有自旋旋转对称性在向列相中被打破，这可以理解为自旋-研究相。我们开发了一个具有独立向量和张量场的经典连续体场论，并使用均值场和重整化群方法来分析其相位和有限温度跃迁。我们使用围绕六的上临界维度的扩展来确定固定点结构，并使用扰动固定维度重整群方法将所得固定点跟踪到较低维度。

item.title: 晶体对称性预示着非常规磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ziyin Song, Zhong Fang, Chen Fang, Hongming Weng
非常规补偿磁体将零净磁化强度与动量相关的自旋极化相结合，但识别它们通常需要了解其磁序。在这里，我们证明晶体对称性可以在磁基态已知之前限制非常规磁特性。从非磁性晶体结构和指定的磁性亚晶格开始，我们生成对称兼容的补偿级，并使用自旋空间群对称性对它们的自旋纹理进行分类。我们识别出生成的候选材料都是非常规的，无论是在定义的搜索空间中还是在限制磁性单元尺寸之后。在实验基准中，68% 的优先材料是非常规材料，而其余材料只有 9%。筛选材料项目产生了数千种有前途的非常规补偿磁性候选材料。

item.title: Hamiltonian learning reveals optoelectronic mechanisms across thermodynamic state space in soft semiconductors

item.title: Hidden magnetic order within the pressure induced superconducting dome of UTe2
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kaixin Ye, Lubin Wang, Dengpeng Yuan, Binbin Zhang, Yanan Zhang, Ye Chen 等15位作者

UTe₂ is a promising candidate for exhibiting multiple spin-triplet superconducting phases when tuning with applied pressure and magnetic fields, but the nature of the magnetism driving these unconventional pairing states is undetermined. Our measurements of UTe₂ under applied pressures and magnetic fields reveal the presence of a magnetic order hidden within the pressure-induced superconducting dome, which vanishes together with the superconductivity once there is sufficiently high pressure to induce the three-dimensional antiferromagnetic phase. item.title: Image-potential states on a 2D Gr-ferromagnet hybrid: enhancing spin and stacking sensing
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Maciej Bazarnik, Anika Schlenhoff
